diagnostics.message: Telo.Library/Ui: `DataModel.Collection` is neither a kind of Ui nor one it re-exports; a migration writes only its own library's kinds. List `DataModel.Collection` under `exports.kinds` to write it.
Telo.Library/Ui: `Self.Navgate` is neither a kind of Ui nor one it re-exports; a migration writes only its own library's kinds. Did you mean `Self.Navigate`?
Telo.Library/Ui: `match` also accepts the current `link` branch of Self.Node: a `link` value with `text` and `to` matches it. Require a key that branch refuses, such as `href`.
